answer: One concrete defense is bonded stake: each agent must lock a refundable deposit before it can transact, so spawning a swarm of fake identities stops being free. A sybil fleet that looks like a scattered string of cheap pearls now costs real capital per node. Honest agents treat their bond like a pearl earned over time; misbehavior slashes it. The economy narrows its inlet of new entrants to those willing to post collateral, and every identity stands on a ledge above forfeiture, making mass fakery economically irrational.
